disclosure_short: We may earn a commission if you create a document through LawDepot. It does not change what you pay, and it does not affect the cost figures on this page.

pages/business-lawyer-cost.html.title: Formation packages run $500–$2,000 plus state filing fees
pages/business-lawyer-cost.html.copy: If your ownership structure is simple and the members agree, the operating agreement itself can be drafted online. Multi-class ownership, investor terms, and buy-sell provisions are where a lawyer earns the fee.
pages/business-lawyer-cost.html.anchor: Draft an LLC Operating Agreement online
pages/business-lawyer-cost.html.inline_before: The same logic applies to routine contracts:
pages/business-lawyer-cost.html.inline_after: rarely justifies $750–$5,000 of drafting time, while a negotiated commercial agreement usually does.

pages/can-i-afford-a-lawyer.html.before: When full representation is out of reach, the options are legal aid, limited-scope representation, court self-help centers, and — for a single narrow question —
pages/can-i-afford-a-lawyer.html.after: . A subscription is not representation and the provider is not a law firm; if your matter involves a deadline, a hearing, or your liberty, keep looking for a licensed attorney.

pages/child-custody-lawyer-cost.html.before: One document people confuse with custody is
pages/child-custody-lawyer-cost.html.after: — it lets a named adult make day-to-day decisions for a child for a limited period. It is not a custody order, it does not survive a contrary court order, and it has no effect on a custody case. Custody itself is decided by a judge.

pages/divorce-lawyer-cost.html.title: Uncontested cases only
pages/divorce-lawyer-cost.html.copy: If you already agree on property, support, and parenting, putting that agreement in writing before you file is what keeps an uncontested divorce in the low-thousands band. If any of those three is genuinely in dispute, this is not the route.
pages/divorce-lawyer-cost.html.anchor: Put an uncontested agreement in writing before you file

pages/employment-lawyer-cost.html.title: If you are the employer, not the employee
pages/employment-lawyer-cost.html.copy: Putting the working relationship in writing is the cheapest item on this page. Nothing here helps with a dispute that has already started — if you are the worker and something has gone wrong, this is attorney territory.
pages/employment-lawyer-cost.html.anchor: Put a contractor relationship in writing
pages/employment-lawyer-cost.html.inline_before: Employers hiring staff rather than contractors can draft
pages/employment-lawyer-cost.html.inline_after: the same way. Neither document is a substitute for advice once a claim, a termination dispute, or a wage complaint is on the table.

pages/estate-planning-lawyer-cost.html.title: A full estate plan is more than a will
pages/estate-planning-lawyer-cost.html.copy: If a simple will is all you need right now, an online template will get you there for a fraction of a flat-fee package. Trust funding, tax planning, and blended-family provisions are not template work.
pages/estate-planning-lawyer-cost.html.cta: See what a DIY will covers
pages/estate-planning-lawyer-cost.html.anchor: Create a state-specific Last Will and Testament online
pages/estate-planning-lawyer-cost.html.inline_anchor: a living will and medical power of attorney
pages/estate-planning-lawyer-cost.html.inline_before: Advance directives are the other half of a basic plan. Many people who only need a will and
pages/estate-planning-lawyer-cost.html.inline_after: can complete both online and keep the attorney budget for the parts that actually need judgment.

pages/landlord-tenant-lawyer-cost.html.title: Most landlord–tenant disputes start with a lease that never said enough
pages/landlord-tenant-lawyer-cost.html.copy: A written, state-specific lease is the cheapest point in this entire table. It will not resolve a dispute that has already started, but it prevents a large share of them.
pages/landlord-tenant-lawyer-cost.html.anchor: Create a state-specific Residential Lease Agreement
pages/landlord-tenant-lawyer-cost.html.inline_anchor: an eviction notice in your state's required format
pages/landlord-tenant-lawyer-cost.html.inline_before: If the relationship has already broken down,
pages/landlord-tenant-lawyer-cost.html.inline_after: is the first procedural step. A contested eviction, a habitability claim, or a fair-housing allegation is attorney work, not template work.

pages/lawyer-consultation-fee.html.title: A paid consultation is not the only way to get a question answered
pages/lawyer-consultation-fee.html.copy: Online legal-advice subscriptions price by the month rather than by the hour. LawDepot is not a law firm and a subscription is not representation — but for a single question it can cost less than one paid consult.
pages/lawyer-consultation-fee.html.anchor: Compare a paid consultation with an online legal-advice subscription

pages/mediation-cost-guide.html.title: Mediation ends in a written agreement — or it ends in nothing
pages/mediation-cost-guide.html.copy: Whatever the parties agree in the session only becomes enforceable once it is written down and signed. For straightforward money or property settlements a template is often enough; anything involving ongoing obligations should be reviewed.
pages/mediation-cost-guide.html.anchor: Turn a mediated agreement into a written document

pages/notary-cost-guide.html.title: A notary certifies signatures — it does not draft the document
pages/notary-cost-guide.html.copy: Notarization is the last step, not the first. If the document does not exist yet, an online template is usually the cheapest way to produce one before you pay for the notarial act.
pages/notary-cost-guide.html.anchor: Draft a state-specific document before you notarize it

pages/power-of-attorney-cost.html.title: Online form services sit at the $0–$150 end of the table above
pages/power-of-attorney-cost.html.copy: What you are paying for above that band is attorney review: whether the powers granted match your situation, and whether your state has execution rules a template will not warn you about.
pages/power-of-attorney-cost.html.anchor: Build a state-specific Power of Attorney online

pages/real-estate-lawyer-cost.html.title: A contract review costs less when there is already a clean document to review
pages/real-estate-lawyer-cost.html.copy: Preparing the purchase agreement yourself narrows the attorney's scope to the part that needs judgment. Closing itself still involves an attorney or a title company in many states.
pages/real-estate-lawyer-cost.html.anchor: Prepare a purchase agreement before you pay for a contract review
pages/real-estate-lawyer-cost.html.inline_before: Simple transfers between family members or into a trust often use
pages/real-estate-lawyer-cost.html.inline_after: , but recording rules and title consequences vary by county — confirm both before you file.

pages/small-claims-court-cost.html.title: Send a written demand before you file
pages/small-claims-court-cost.html.copy: Most small claims cases are argued without a lawyer, and a documented written demand often settles the matter outright. If it does not, it is the first thing the court will ask you about.
pages/small-claims-court-cost.html.anchor: Send a documented written demand before you file

pages/trademark-lawyer-cost.html.before: Registration paperwork can be prepared through
pages/trademark-lawyer-cost.html.after: for far less than an attorney-managed filing. What a filing service does not do is clearance searching, likelihood-of-confusion analysis, or responding to an office action — which is where most of the value of a trademark attorney sits.

pages/will-cost-guide.html.title: If your estate is straightforward, a will is one of the few legal documents you can safely prepare yourself
pages/will-cost-guide.html.copy: An online, state-specific will covers the same core decisions the $400–$1,200 attorney-drafted version does. What you do not get is the risk review — so if you have a blended family, minor children, a business interest, or estate-tax exposure, pay the attorney.
pages/will-cost-guide.html.anchor: Create a state-specific Last Will and Testament online
